scope: Licensed static atlas anatomy with an original limited rigid-bone educational driver. Sliders show sagittal/frontal projections, not registered ankle/subtalar kinematics. Muscle mode restores neutral anatomy; muscles are never deformed or used to compute forces.
displayModifications: Source positions, normals and indices remain unchanged. Runtime identification colours and clipping are display only.
Original teaching driver rotates talus and distal bones around an explicitly approximate transverse pivot; tibia/fibula stay fixed.
A separate nested frontal projection rotates distal foot bones without talus around an explicitly approximate anteroposterior pivot. No excluded joint-chain definitions are used.
Static licensed calf muscles can be added in neutral position only. No inferred skin weights, muscle contraction, activation, force or patient-specific measurements.

teachingDriver.coordinateConvention: Y up metres; anterior +Z; right foot medial +X

dorsiflexion.moving: talus and all distal foot bones

inversion.moving: all distal foot bones except talus

teachingDriver.rangeMeaning: Author-selected bounded demonstration controls, not normative clinical range or patient measurements.
teachingDriver.limitation: Pivots and orthogonal axes are teaching approximations, not anatomically registered joint axes. The ankle complex has oblique, coupled multi-joint motions. No contact solver or clinical arthrokinematics is implemented.
